title: Mapping Europe’s AI Workforce Opportunity
summary: A new OpenAI report maps how AI could reshape jobs across the EU, highlighting which occupations may face automation, growth, or workflow changes.
body: A new OpenAI report maps how AI could reshape jobs across the EU, highlighting which occupations may face automation, growth, or workflow changes.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了一份关于欧洲AI劳动力机遇的新报告，详细映射了人工智能技术在欧盟重塑各类职业岗位的潜力。报告指出了哪些行业可能面临自动化转型、工作流重组或显著的职位增长，为政策制定者和企业提供了前瞻性的宏观参考。
